# Semantic Verification

The semantic verification process shadows a full compile to check for equivalence with the current state without making any writes. It helps identify changes in the knowledge base and ensures that the incremental history aligns with a fresh full compile.

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run.verify`
